english.note: Use this common alternative when describing something as notably or widely known, often with 好有名.

exampleSentences.english: This tourist spot is very famous among visitors.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個景點喺遊客之間好有名。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 ging2 dim2 hai2 jau4 haak3 zi1 gaan1 hou2 jau5 meng2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is famous or well-known for their achievements.

exampleSentences.traditional: 佢係一位有名嘅建築師。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 jau5 meng2 ge3 gin3 zuk1 si1
